message: The new readOnly early return in handleSubmit has no test, so deleting it leaves every test green. The Confirmation gate it replaced (!readOnly) was also removed with no replacement coverage.
dismissalDetail: the guard is defensive and the page cannot reach it in a test: nothing refetches the questionnaire while the dialog is open, so it only turns read-only from this page's own submit; the guard is a cheap stop for a stale cache and the API refuses a second submit

message: The new readOnly guard says it covers a spouse who submitted while the dialog was open, but nothing refetches the questionnaire while the dialog is up, so that race still reaches the API and fails with NOT_FOUND.
dismissalDetail: agreed that nothing refetches the questionnaire while the dialog is open, so it only turns read-only from this page's own submit; the guard is a cheap stop for a stale cache and the API refuses a second submit

message: Neither Summary change is tested: deleting the readOnly guard or restoring isOpen={confirmOpen && !readOnly} leaves Summary.test.tsx and SummaryReadOnly.test.tsx green.
dismissalDetail: same unreachable case as #24; the gate was removed in 443737a7a because it closed the dialog mid-submit

message: The error branch runs before the cached-data check, so a failed background refetch hides the menu item for a non-New-Staff household member even though the cache shows a questionnaire, which the new comment says cannot happen.
dismissalDetail: the error branch order came with #2311 (MPDX-10402) and this PR does not change it

message: The language-change test asserts English text under fr, which holds only because French translations do not load in jest, and it never asserts Step 4 after clicking Back.
dismissalDetail: the test pins that the reader stays on Step 4 after a language change; jest loads English only, so the heading text stays readable

message: If readOnly flips true while the dialog is idle, the dialog now stays open with an enabled Submit, and clicking it closes the dialog with no message.
dismissalDetail: same unreachable case as #24: nothing refetches the questionnaire while the dialog is open, so it only turns read-only from this page's own submit; the guard is a cheap stop for a stale cache and the API refuses a second submit

message: Escape or a backdrop click can still close the dialog while the submit is running, so the spinner fix is partial.
dismissalDetail: Confirmation closes on Escape and backdrop the same way before this PR

message: When a spouse submits while the confirm dialog is open, the dialog now stays up and still asks the user to submit. Clicking Submit silently returns with no message that it was already submitted.
dismissalDetail: same unreachable case as #24: nothing refetches the questionnaire while the dialog is open, so it only turns read-only from this page's own submit; the guard is a cheap stop for a stale cache and the API refuses a second submit

message: The new test resets i18n to a hard-coded en instead of the starting language, so later tests in the file run under a different language.
dismissalDetail: jest always starts in English (the test setup loads the en bundle), so en is the starting language
